title: Bio-based cellulose benzenesulfonic acid-catalyzed dehydration of fructose to 5-hydroxymethylfurfural
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10511-10521
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08540J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aniwat Pengsawang, Atthapon Srifa, Vorranutch Itthibenchapong
The CBSA, a cellulosic-structured solid acid catalyst, was successfully synthesized and achieved 100% fructose conversion with an 85% 5-HMF yield under mild temperature conditions.
